ValidationRule.description:
All fields related to discounts Visa Required Notes Risk & Concerns Notes Billing Currency
Are required to move to VC or Won stage for AE profile
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
Owner.Profile.Name = 'AE User' && ISCHANGED(StageName)
&& OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Verbal Commit"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") )
&& of_Opportunity_Products__c != Products_With_Discount_Fields_NEW__c
&& RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Partner" && RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Expansion_Upsell"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please make sure that all opportunity products have the following fields filled in: Discount Type, Discount Duration, Discount %, Visa Required Notes, Risk & Concerns Notes, Billing Currency
